facts.text: The resort is steps from the sand, historic Highway 101 and the coastal town of Encinitas, and blends into the bluffs in an eco design.
facts.excerpt: Steps from sunlit sand, historic Highway 101 and the coastal town of Encinitas, Alila Marea Beach Resort blends seamlessly into the bluffs in an innovative expression of eco design.

facts.text: The hotel is tailored for adults seeking a refined coastal escape.
facts.excerpt: Tailored for adults seeking a refined coastal escape

facts.text: The resort is designed to emulate the surrounding coastal bluff, beach and ocean, framed by natural stone, warm woods and clean lines.
facts.excerpt: Designed to emulate the surrounding coastal bluff, beach and ocean, the resort is framed by natural stone, warm woods and clean lines

facts.text: Nearly every room has coastal views.
facts.excerpt: Alila Marea combines understated elegance with coastal views from nearly every room.

facts.text: Occupancy is limited to two people per room to keep the atmosphere tranquil.
facts.excerpt: We maintain an atmosphere of tranquility with a maximum occupancy of two people per room to ensure the comfort of all guests.

facts.text: Large-scale works by artist in residence Aaron Chang hang in the resort, and surfboard wall panels by local board shaper Brian Szymanski decorate The Pocket.
facts.excerpt: Large-scale pieces by our artist in residence, Aaron Chang, inspire contemplation, while surfboard wall panels by local board shaper Brian Szymanski infuse The Pocket with beachside energy.

facts.text: South Ponto State Beach is steps from the resort, and a Beach Concierge provides beach chairs, beach games and surfboards.
facts.excerpt: Discover one of the county's most expansive beaches, South Ponto State Beach, just steps from Alila Marea. Our Beach Concierge is at your service with beach chairs, beach games, surf boards and more.

facts.text: Private seaside cabanas and daybeds can be booked on the pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your pool deck experience at Alila Marea with a private seaside cabana or daybed.

facts.text: Spa Alila offers wellness experiences including breathwork, astrology consultations and sound healing sessions.
facts.excerpt: Delve into transformative wellness experiences that go beyond the physical, including breathwork, astrology consultations and sound healing sessions.

facts.text: Spa Alila treatments use minerals and botanicals sourced from the natural landscape.
facts.excerpt: offering treatments with thoughtfully sourced minerals and botanicals from the natural landscape

facts.text: The Endless Wave surf experience offers expert instructors, demo boards and hidden breaks.
facts.excerpt: Expert instructors, demo boards, legendary waters and hidden breaks await as you dive into surf culture and support the effort to keep our waters clean.

facts.text: Part of the cost of The Endless Wave supports the Rob Machado Foundation, which promotes clean oceans and drinking water.
facts.excerpt: A portion of the cost supports the Rob Machado Foundation, which promotes clean oceans and drinking water.

facts.text: Guests can explore Leucadia, Encinitas, Carlsbad and Cardiff-by-the-Sea on electric-assist bikes.
facts.excerpt: Take an electric-assist bike for a spin along the coast for an environmentally friendly way to explore Leucadia, Encinitas, Carlsbad and Cardiff-by-the-Sea

facts.text: Solar power preheats the pool and water.
facts.excerpt: Our green initiatives include solar power for all pool and water preheating

facts.text: Some rooms have an oversized patio with a private firepit and seating.
facts.excerpt: an oversized patio with private firepit and cozy seating for you and your guests

facts.text: Each room has a rack for hanging wetsuits.
facts.excerpt: Guests who enjoy getting wet can hang their wetsuits on the convenient racks in each room.

facts.text: The Grandview Suite has picture windows overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon, floor-to-ceiling windows facing the Pacific, and a double-sided fireplace opening to a patio.
facts.excerpt: with three large picture windows overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon and west-facing floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing Pacific Ocean views. The double-sided fireplace opens up to an outdoor living space on the patio

facts.text: VAGA Restaurant & Bar serves coastal cuisine with sweeping ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Savor coastal cuisine at VAGA Restaurant & Bar at Alila Marea Beach Resort Encinitas, where locally inspired flavors meet sweeping ocean views.

facts.text: The Pocket is a surf-inspired bar with a view.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a hangout with a view at this surf-inspired bar in Encinitas.

facts.text: First-floor rooms have quick access to the beach stairway, the pool deck and The Pocket.
facts.excerpt: located on the first floor for quick access to the beach stairway, pool deck, and The Pocket

facts.text: Seaside Intention Yoga leads guests through mindful movement and an intention-setting exercise using cobblestones on Ponto Beach.
facts.excerpt: Our instructors will lead you through mindful movement and an intention-setting exercise using cobblestones on Ponto Beach.

facts.text: Guests can hike the surrounding coastal wetland of Batiquitos Lagoon.
facts.excerpt: hike the surrounding coastal wetland of Batiquitos Lagoon

facts.text: The local stretch of Pacific beach can be rockier than others, so a chair is more useful than a towel.
facts.excerpt: this stretch of Pacific beaches can be a little rockier than others, so bring a chair rather than a towel if you can.

facts.text: The hotel does not offer self-parking.
facts.excerpt: Please note the hotel does not offer self-parking.

facts.text: The resort caters to adults and couples more than younger generations.
facts.excerpt: Alila Marea caters to high net worth adults and couples more than Gen Z or Alpha.

facts.text: The Ponto surf break is better for beginners.
facts.excerpt: Ponto surf break is better for beginners

facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly.
facts.excerpt: Our dog-friendly hotel welcomes your pets to Encinitas.

facts.text: Opened in March 2021 as the first new-build Alila resort in the Americas.
facts.excerpt: Opened in March 2021, Alila Marea is the first new-build Alila resort in the Americas

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler calls the service, amenities, spa and dining world-class.
facts.excerpt: Plus, the service, amenities, spa, and dining options are world-class.
